correctness.rationale: Reconstructed facet area*support normalization: each ±coordinate pair yields log cosh(z_i), and |det A|=1 gives affine covariance. Setting g(u)=log cosh(sqrt u), direct derivative g<0 yields Jensen maximal on equal squared coordinates and subadditive lower bound attained at one coordinate. Sharp inner and outer Euclidean radii and complete contacts follow. Signed-coordinate permutations force both unique extremal ellipsoids to be balls; averaging candidate quadratic forms proves no noninvariant ellipsoid improves Banach–Mazur ratio. The inverse-square radius h(s)=arcosh(e^s)^2 is strictly convex, and its increasing elasticity yields monotonicity; elementary asymptotics give endpoint/dimension limits. Independently recomputed derivative signs and checked values; numerical verifications not universal proofs.
